editorial:
Imagine moving to a quiet town only to find out the neighbors are part of a creepy religious group. That is exactly what happens here. You follow a young girl who gets caught up in the influence of this strange cult. The vibe is very unsettling because it feels like something is wrong, but you cannot quite put your finger on it at first. The movie does a great job of making you feel the tension as the girl starts to change and pull away from her family. It is a slow burn that keeps you wondering how far the cult will go to keep her.

The acting is surprisingly natural, and the way the mystery unfolds keeps you glued to the screen. While some parts of the story move a bit slow, the payoff at the end makes it all worth it. If you enjoy stories about secret societies and family drama, you will love this. You should definitely look for the 4K Blu-ray to add to your physical collection for the best picture quality, or you can easily rent it on Apple TV for a movie night. It is a hidden gem that looks great in high definition.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, you find out the cult believes the girl is a vessel for their god. They try to perform a ritual to fully take over her mind during a big ceremony. However, her father arrives just in time to break the spell and pull her away. The movie ends with the cult leader being arrested, but the girl is left with strange memories that suggest she might still be connected to them.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves mysteries about secret cults and psychological drama.
